description: 市内橋梁データ [roads, bridges and tunnels] is a dataset listed in BODIK Open Data Catalogue Service (data.bodik.jp), Japanese local governments, an open data portal, published or maintained by 直方市. ・対象年 2025年1. 1～12. 31 ・データの種類 対象月の主要導線分析 ・データ項目 橋梁名、時間帯、道路ID、性別、年代、居住地 データ提供：KDDI・技研商事インターナショナル「KDDI Location Analyzer」 調査に用いたデータは au(KDDI)スマートフォンの位置情報ビッグデータ。 （auスマートフォンユ... Coverage: 直方市. The portal files it under the publisher 直方市. It offers 1 resource(s) in csv. The portal shows 2026-03-29 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Japanese; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-jp-bodik-portal.
